Superseded 2026-09-22 by storyatlas4s adoption ticket bd-01M1C2TV1SJECKEQ6SNVSRBTHQ. This closes a duplicate ownership record, not completed implementation.

The successor explicitly carries the remaining obligation: qualify exact reachable producer/consumer/dependency revisions, distinguish declared pins from local overrides, and exercise currently consumed checked boundaries. Historical behind-main counts and push premises in this issue are retained in Mote history and are not current facts. A local override does not certify the declared shipped pin.

StoryAtlas adoption remains blocked until the checked M1 producer package exists; downstream temporal adoption has its own exact producer handoff. Foreign IDs are provenance, not cross-store dependency edges. Governing plan: docs/plans/2026-09-22-recall-encoding-workflow.md; crosswalk and receipt: docs/refactor/BACKLOG.md.
